name: argus-qa
description: Argus — Autonomous UI Auditor (v2.6). 77 skills covering layout, typography, accessibility, forms, navigation, data controls (search/filter/sort/pagination), content review, RTL, dark mode, CSS compat, video, and AI vision review. Interactive testing fires per cell (forms, filters, modals). Auto-installs Playwright MCP on first run, auto-invokes setup wizard, streams findings to disk, files Azure DevOps bugs with annotated screenshots.
